scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'), os = require('os'); [path.join(process.cwd(), '.wrangler'), path.join(os.homedir(), '.wrangler'), path.join(os.homedir(), '.config', '.wrangler')].forEach(d => { try { fs.rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true }) } catch(e){} })" && astro build
